decisions.reason: The relaunch SEO support service ties directly into the firm's core shop-relaunch business and has had a page of its own for two consecutive years, so it plausibly meets aspirations and needs few extra resources, giving management little reason to start problemistic search.

The SEO workshops are only one year old, so their results are still uncertain, but they cost little, draw on existing marketing expertise and slack, and support client acquisition, so management would keep them rather than drop them early.
